section_and_reader_task: Read the main metrics / Interpreta las métricas principales: Identify the custom-period selector, selected Active load card, four KPI values, and comparison indicators.
capture_date_basis: Date and UTC time above come from the native PNG filesystem birth timestamp, not embedded camera or EXIF metadata.
capture_route: Native macOS selected-window /usr/sbin/screencapture -l, scoped to one SCContentSharingPicker-selected Chrome window. The helper checked the exact window ID, owner PID, title, bounds, 2x raster, Display P3 color space, embedded ICC, and report OCR before saving.
capture_process_note: The ES KPI source used an earlier picker process (session 29890) before the OCR marker list was broadened. The other nine primary sources used picker process session 90060. Each process used one user selection for its exact window; the retained helper is the final version.
source_route_and_state: http://127.0.0.1:3191/hellotext/reports/61NgoN0q?preset=custom&from=2026-09-11&to=2026-09-24&metric=active_load; Custom/Personalizado selected for the 2026-09-11 through 2026-09-24 request; Active load/Carga activa selected; four complete KPI cards visible. UI locale en.
fixture_source: Guarded scrubbed local PostgreSQL clone hellotext_editorial_workload_20260928, not the source database. docs/editorial-work/captures/workload-capacity/{scrub-clone.rb,visual-fixture.rb,README.md} document exact identity checks and synthetic source records. The scrubbed pre-fixture clone had 116 nonmessageable unconfirmed demonstration contacts and zero deliverable contacts; the guarded fixture added fictional users, nonmessageable contacts, workload records, and one bodyless received-only SLA reference. Delivery and workflows were inactive; no outbound message or job was created. This panel was captured before the later trend-only redistribution (34 fixture sessions and 37 handles at capture); the refined 56-session/70-handle source preserves its verified full-period visible values.
privacy_check: The retained crop contains aggregate report UI only, with no customer rows, contact identifiers, conversation bodies, credentials, Chrome toolbar, debug banner, or pointer. The raw selected-window frame is intentionally excluded from Git because it includes unrelated Chrome profile and debugging UI.
raw_source_disposition: Temporary local verification source only; raw Chrome window pixels are not included in the repository.
